newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Spring/White Wheat - Basis up, movement slow.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Spring/White Wheat - Basis up, movement slow.

text.p: Basis levels for dark northern spring wheat rose on Friday in line with higher MGE wheat futures, dealers said.
But they said bitter cold temperatures across Montana and the Dakotas hampered movement.
MGE spring wheat closed 3-1/2 to 4-3/4 cents per bushel higher, with March up 4-3/4 cents at $3.93-1/2.
Brokers noted that the snow that has buried much of the northern U.S. Plains in the past week has virtually paralyzed grain movement, helping to firm up basis levels.
"We bought a lot of wheat last week" but nothing on Monday, a Montana merchandiser said.

On Monday, Pakistan bought a total of 315,000 tonnes wheat, of which 180,000 tonnes was Australian white wheat and 135,000 tonnes was U.S. soft white wheat for February 1-28 delivery, several U.S. exporters said.
